stem: Propagation is designated as a cleaner zone than late-flower rooms. Which work sequence best supports that zoning concept when staffing allows?
choices: Move from higher-risk rooms into propagation without changing work practices
Perform cleaner-zone work before higher-risk work, or complete required decontamination before moving back into cleaner zones
Always begin in the room with the most visible symptoms
rationale: Work sequencing and decontamination reduce movement of contaminants from higher-risk zones into cleaner areas.
